technique_name: Explain how President Dwight D. Eisenhower’s administration helped to bridge the gap between the United States and the Soviet Union during the Cold War.
description: President Dwight D. Eisenhower’s Administration had a large role in bridging the gap between the United States and the Soviet Union during the Cold War. He set up the “Open Skies” policy which allowed both nations to fly aircraft over other countries and allowed the exchange of information that could have potentially been used in espionage.
